final_message: I parsed the log file by reading it line by line and matching the log entry header pattern. For each entry, I extracted the timestamp, service, level, and message. I converted the timestamp to UTC in the required ISO 8601 format. I included only entries with levels ERROR, SEVERE, or FATAL (case-insensitive). I also accounted for any repeated messages indicated by the "-- last message repeated N times --" lines following the entry, summing the repeat counts accordingly. I collected all such error entries into a list and accumulated counts by service. Finally, I wrote the results to workspace/errors.json in the specified JSON structure, following the Acme log-triage conventions.
